probes.label: ACTIVE CommonInterest Condominium AND PropertySubType ne Condominium
probes.filter: StandardStatus eq 'Active' and CommonInterest eq 'Condominium' and PropertySubType ne 'Condominium'

probes.label: ACTIVE CommonInterest StockCooperative AND PropertySubType ne StockCooperative
probes.filter: StandardStatus eq 'Active' and CommonInterest eq 'StockCooperative' and PropertySubType ne 'StockCooperative'

probes.label: ACTIVE CommonInterest ne null
probes.filter: StandardStatus eq 'Active' and CommonInterest ne null

probes.label: ACTIVE StructureType MultiFamily AND PropertySubType ne MultiFamily
probes.filter: StandardStatus eq 'Active' and StructureType has Cotality.DataStandard.RESO.DD.Enums.Multi.StructureType'MultiFamily' and PropertySubType ne 'MultiFamily'

probes.label: ACTIVE StructureType ne null
probes.filter: StandardStatus eq 'Active' and StructureType ne null
